installation.api: Existing native Paperclip API; no alternate controller or importer.
installation.newAgent: POST /api/companies/${COMPANY_ID}/agents with resolved payload plus instructionsBundle:{entryFile:"AGENTS.md",files:{"AGENTS.md":<instructionFile contents>}}. Create Astra, leads, then developers/reviewers and resolve reportsTo from actual responses.
installation.existingAgent: Match the private owner-maintained key-to-agent mapping. PATCH /api/agents/${AGENT_ID} with explicitly reviewed configuration fields; permissions use the existing board-only permission endpoint. PUT /api/agents/${AGENT_ID}/instructions-bundle/file with {path:"AGENTS.md",content:<resolved instructionFile>,baseRevisionId:<fresh revision ID>}. Do not replace lifecycle state, holds, task history or current runtime binding.
installation.placeholders: Resolve PROJECT_ROOT/RUNTIME_ROOT, native agent/project/workspace IDs and owner-bound delegated subscription fields locally. Never send unresolved placeholders to the API or commit binding values.
installation.environment: Plain env values are placeholders for local bindings; API responses can redact them. Do not infer original values or switch subscription access to paid API keys.
installation.workspace: No legacy cwd is required. Register current project workspaces through native API; source tasks explicitly use configured_source/managed_isolated, publisher fixed shared workspace.
installation.readback: Fresh GET verifies model/effort, reporting, permissions, instruction revision, heartbeat disabled and unchanged pause/holds. Configuration import never authorizes a run.
installation.history: Retired profiles, qualification fixtures, existing STOP/rejection/unknown-effect records and historical fixed processes stay in the private live database; these templates do not recreate or delete them.
installation.researcher: One of the original forty Luna workforce profiles is a constrained read-only researcher with an old phase-specific instruction bundle, retained with an inactive-phase header and local task-pin placeholders. It is not forty interchangeable code implementers; current assignments and holds remain authoritative.
